name: deadline_watch
description: Daily CRON: reads active procedural deadlines due within 30 days from the legal.db SQLite table, builds a J-1/J-7/J-30 digest, emails it to the firm's own inbox as an internal reminder. Never creates/updates calendar events automatically and never emails a third party (guardrail 7.2) — calendar sync stays a deliberate human/agent action.

parameters.sql_query: SELECT d.id, d.dossier_id, do.client, d.type_acte, d.date_butoir, d.confirme_par_avocate, CAST(julianday(d.date_butoir) - julianday('now') AS INTEGER) AS jours_restants FROM delais d JOIN dossiers do ON do.id = d.dossier_id WHERE d.statut = 'actif' AND date(d.date_butoir) <= date('now', '+30 days') ORDER BY d.date_butoir

parameters.script:
import json
rows = json.loads(flow_file.content.decode('utf-8'))

def bucket(j):
    if j <= 1:
        return 'J-1 (URGENT)'
    if j <= 7:
        return 'J-7'
    return 'J-30'

groups = {'J-1 (URGENT)': [], 'J-7': [], 'J-30': []}
for r in rows:
    j = r.get('jours_restants')
    j = 0 if j is None else int(j)
    groups[bucket(j)].append(r)

lines = []
lines.append('Bonjour,')
lines.append('')
lines.append("Voici le point sur les echeances de procedure a moins de 30 jours (rappel automatique, a verifier par vous avant toute action - aucun delai ci-dessous n'est un fait acquis) :")
lines.append('')
any_row = False
for label in ('J-1 (URGENT)', 'J-7', 'J-30'):
    items = groups[label]
    if not items:
        continue
    any_row = True
    lines.append(f'== {label} ==')
    for r in items:
        confirme = 'confirme' if r.get('confirme_par_avocate') else 'NON CONFIRME PAR L AVOCATE'
        lines.append(f"- Dossier {r.get('client')} (id {r.get('dossier_id')}) - {r.get('type_acte')} - echeance {r.get('date_butoir')} ({confirme})")
    lines.append('')
if not any_row:
    lines.append('Aucune echeance active a moins de 30 jours.')
lines.append('')
lines.append('Ce message est un rappel interne automatique. Aucun evenement de calendrier ni email tiers n a ete cree ou envoye par ce flow.')

flow_file.content = '\n'.join(lines).encode('utf-8')
flow_file.set_attribute('digest.deadline_count', str(len(rows)))
